title: Kagamine Len — Street SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that we're here, do you want to go to MEIKO's cafe?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm sure everyone else is there already.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, hello there...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Len! Hi!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's great to see you again!
What are you up to?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We thought we'd come by after practice to say hi to everyone. We were just going to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm going there too.
Let's walk together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you help out at the cafe too?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I only visit as a customer, but Miku does help out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've got another important job in this world as a DJ!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But where's your kit? The turntable and the amp? I've never seen you carrying anything like that around.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heh heh heh.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You think I'm not carrying them right now?
But... I've got this pocket here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: D-Do you have a whole other dimension in your pocket?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's a strange world, this SEKAI... Different rules might apply here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Got ya! I was just kidding.
I don't have a magical pocket.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You don't?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It is a mysterious world, but it's not magical.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I would have believed you if you said it was. It wouldn't surprise me if you could make things appear just by wishing for them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I thought the same.
A lot about this world really is inexplicable.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I wish we could use magic here!
The DJ's kit is awfully heavy and a pain to carry around!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, I bet it is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I used to think that you guys were almost supernatural beings... But you're not that different from us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Our special power is helping people discover their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And that's about it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But that's an amazing power to have!
Without that, we wouldn't even be here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes. Don't sell yourself short!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If you say so.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You did just enough to make it all happen, but not too much so that it would stop us from facing our problems.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. Some problems have to be solved without help, even when they're very difficult.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're tremendously grateful to you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you so much for everything, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel better knowing you see it like that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Buuut, there's something else I can do for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And what's that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm the DJ, so, obviously, I'm going to do some DJing for you when we get to the cafe!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That'd be sweet!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, let's go, go, go!
